title: Execute activation-weighted joint row-Scale32 tensor-codebook W4 candidate

fresh_attempt_namespace.execution_marker_creation_rule: Create atomically exactly once only after independent calibration-statistic identity, two-build candidate identity, V4-relative activation-energy-weighted improvement, 8/8 non-evaluator exactness including four construction-blind holdouts, all 312 Dynamic Scale32 events, and every bound hash pass verification.

implementation_objective: Implement an isolated V5 runner that captures exact BF16 per-input-channel activation-energy statistics from only the four frozen calibration prompts, freshly reconstructs the verified alias-safe model split and V4 baseline, then re-optimizes the existing row Scale32 records and one 16-entry signed-Q4.4 codebook per Linear tensor under the frozen weighted objective with no product metadata growth.

required_calibration_capture.source: pinned BF16 source model and the four prompts in the hash-bound Instruct calibration contract
required_calibration_capture.positions: all prompt-prefill positions plus deterministic BF16 greedy rollout through at most six generated tokens
required_calibration_capture.per_module_statistic: exact H_j=sum(x_j^2) on a module-local dyadic integer lattice for every input channel of all 169 Linear modules, with max(H_j,1) followed only by whole-vector greatest-common-divisor reduction
required_calibration_capture.independent_capture: two fresh captures must produce byte-identical H vectors, prompt token hashes, BF16 generated calibration token arrays, position counts, and aggregate manifests

required_constructor.initialization: freshly recompute the complete V4 eight-iteration unweighted joint result from pinned BF16 weights; do not import V4 mutable state
required_constructor.objective: exact sum H_j*(weight_ij-reconstruction_ij)^2 across every tensor
required_constructor.assignment: nearest reconstructed row_scale*codepoint/16; lower index wins exact ties
required_constructor.row_scale_update: exact H-weighted dyadic least-squares ideal constrained by absmax*16/127 and legal Scale32 range; evaluate bracketing legal records, immediate significand neighbors, and prior record; minimize weighted row SSE with frozen tie rules
required_constructor.codebook_update: exact H-weighted per-cluster quadratic costs over all 256 signed-Q4.4 values plus dynamic programming for the globally minimum-cost strictly increasing 16-entry codebook; empty clusters retain prior values; lexicographically smaller codebook wins cost ties
required_constructor.monotonicity: activation-energy-weighted tensor objective may not increase across any outer iteration
required_constructor.determinism: independent candidate A and B calibration, payload, row-scale, codebook, reconstruction, weighted-objective, iteration-trace, weight, and state manifests must match byte-for-byte

model_and_alias_policy.source_alias_assertion: lm_head.weight and model.embed_tokens.weight are the same Parameter and storage immediately after pinned-model load
model_and_alias_policy.split_operation: clone the complete embedding tensor into a detached non-trainable lm_head Parameter before construction and set only in-memory tie_word_embeddings false
model_and_alias_policy.embedding_preservation: original embedding object, storage, shape, dtype, and complete BF16 bytes remain unchanged
model_and_alias_policy.quantization_scope: exactly 168 transformer Linears plus separated lm_head

storage_and_accelerator_contract.weight_payload: one unsigned 4-bit codebook index per weight
storage_and_accelerator_contract.row_scale: one existing 32-bit Scale32 record per output row; zero additional bytes
storage_and_accelerator_contract.codebook: one aligned 16-byte signed-Q4.4 record per Linear tensor

required_before_marker: hash-bound runner and exact weighted-constructor self-test result
two independent exact calibration-statistic captures and equality manifest
candidate A and B state, payload, row-scale, codebook, reconstruction, weighted-objective, and iteration-trace manifests
constructor tests for weighted Scale32 bracketing/neighbors/ties/range/all-zero rows and weighted strict-codebook DP optimum/empty clusters/ties/range/packing/hash rejection
model-only report with 169/169 V4-relative activation-energy-weighted non-regression and strict aggregate improvement
the same eight non-evaluator inputs at 8/8 exact BF16 token arrays and 8/8 matching response-gate outcomes, explicitly labeling the four construction prompts and four construction-blind holdouts
fresh-candidate Dynamic Scale32 report with all 312 layer/event names, legal deltas, zero saturation, zero clipping, and no reserved -128 payload
predeclared contract binding every source, model, calibration, matrix, runner, tool version, format, and policy hash
PREATTEMPT_READY.json that verifies all prior artifacts without creating execution_started.json
pre_attempt_artifact_set.preflight_failure_disposition: Preserve a hash-bound PREATTEMPT_NO_GO, leave attempt-0001 absent and unconsumed, keep selected_policy_id null, and submit the no-go to a Fresh Reviewer without accessing official inputs.

official_attempt_contract.generation: deterministic greedy argmax; no sampling; use_cache=false; maximum six generated tokens; termination IDs 151643 and 151645
official_attempt_contract.score_policy: binary only: 9/9 complete token arrays exactly equal BF16 and 9/9 response-gate outcomes equal BF16
official_attempt_contract.evaluator_no_execution_rule: If execution_started.json exists but no candidate prompt completes, preserve the attempt, keep numerical correctness null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt_contract.numerical_failure_rule: If any candidate prompt completes but the binary gate is not met, set eligible=false, preserve exact disagreements, keep selected_policy_id null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt_contract.numerical_success_rule: If the 9/9 binary gate is met, seal immutable evidence and submit it to a Fresh Reviewer; do not select the policy or authorize downstream work before independent acceptance.

acceptance_check: A Fresh Reviewer independently verifies task/hash closure, exact duplicate calibration-statistic capture, source-tied then runtime-split lm_head behavior, preserved embedding bytes, deterministic eight-iteration activation-weighted construction within 4.036 bits per weight, strict V4-relative weighted improvement, 8/8 preflight exactness including four construction-blind holdouts, legal 312-event Dynamic Scale32 execution, and—only if the official marker exists—9/9 exact BF16 token arrays plus 9/9 matching response-gate outcomes.
prohibited_work: modify, resume, replay, reinterpret, or officially execute V4 or any consumed predecessor
create the V5 execution marker during planning, runner development, calibration capture, construction, or preflight
use official nine-prompt inputs, outputs, token arrays, or response gates for calibration, construction, or preflight
use the four additional non-evaluator holdout inputs for calibration or construction
add calibration statistics to the product image or runtime, per-group or per-scalar weight metadata, sparse exceptions, wider payloads, extra row records, or more than one codebook per Linear tensor
modify RTL, testbenches, formal properties, synthesis constraints, certified PPA evidence, or the sealed two-token record
retarget or claim the arbitrary-text demo
begin U280 integration, emulation, bitstream, or board work
